title: Mole Hotpot
paragraphs: “Gungnir X!”
The spear I threw pierced straight through the Chimera’s lion head.
“Hah!”
Before it could hit the ground, I caught the returning spear and swiftly dissected the beast—separating its heads, bones, and meat.
“Alright! That should do it!”
“All that’s left is the rift!”
“Let’s go!”
“Yes!”
Ren and Itsuki fired their Meteor Sword and Meteor Bow at the wave’s rift, and instantly, the disturbance was quelled.
“Now! Absorb the materials into your weapons immediately, and let’s get out of here.”

Father checked the rear. That’s when we noticed a dust cloud rising from the direction of the castle. Focusing our eyes, we could make out a group radiating killing intent. It’s probably the knight order dispatched to kill us.
“Motoyasu, you really are something. Dissecting the Chimera before it even lands…”
“Honestly, shouldn’t that be Ren’s job instead?”
“You’re right. Motoyasu, don’t steal my role.”
“My apologies.”
As we absorbed the Chimera’s remains into our weapons, arrows came flying from the distance. No doubt, those ungrateful wretches are trying to finish us off.
“They haven’t reached us yet, but seriously, how selfish can they be?”
“Exactly… Maybe we should teach them firsthand just how foolish it is to attack heroes.”
“Ren, you’re starting to sound like Motoyasu.”
For some reason, Ren’s expression stiffened at that.
“…You’re right. Now isn’t the time to deal with them. Let’s get out of here.”
“Yeah! Motoyasu-kun, can you open a portal?”

I immediately began preparing the portal. …Though I have to admit, this is starting to irritate me. Looks like they’re preparing some kind of ritual magic against us. Still, it’s nothing we can’t handle.
How foolish can they be? Maybe they need a little lesson. As I concentrated on my magic, I turned toward Father.
“No problem.”
“Alright, then open the portal so we can get out of here.”
“Got it! Portal Spear!”
In the brief moment it took to select the people for teleportation, I formed a spell in my hand.
“Motoyasu! What are you doing?!”
“Just a little warning shot!”
“Someone stop Motoyasu!”
“Gau!”
The rival tried preparing an interference spell, but stopping me completely was impossible.
“Take this! Liberation Prominence!”
With all my might, I hurled the flaming sphere toward the knight order before teleporting away. Father and the others, their faces pale, watched the trajectory of my magic just as we vanished.
“Motoyasu-kun!”
“Why does he always have to leave parting gifts…?”
After we teleported to the neighboring country of Faubrey, Father was the first to scold me, while Ren sighed and pressed a hand to his forehead in exasperation.
“I only punished them because they never learn.”
“By the way, how powerful was the spell you cast?”
“Hmm… Let’s see… It was a spell strong enough to leave them half-cooked but not dead.”
“You released a spell with that much density… and that’s all?”
“Haha, think of it as sunlight so intense it scorches the skin.”
Father and the others all let out deep sighs.
“Well, I was a little irritated, so maybe they deserved it.”
“Unbelievable… Of all things, they chose to fire arrows and magic at the heroes fighting to stop the waves? Just how corrupt are they?”
Éclair shook her head in disbelief.
“But isn’t this strange? I mean, not only did Motoyasu-kun wipe out the king, but he also destroyed the Three Heroes Church… and yet…”
“I was thinking the same thing. If this queen person is as capable as she’s supposed to be, shouldn’t she have handled things more smoothly?”
“I thought so too… It’s hard to imagine the queen ordering the heroes to be killed out of personal resentment.”
“But at the same time, we did kill her beloved husband of many years.”
“And yet, here we are, completely ignoring her daughter’s existence.”
There’s no need to concern ourselves with that filthy pig. That thing is nothing but a nuisance.
“In any case, Melromarc’s insanity has gone too far. We need to properly report this to Faubrey.”
“Agreed. At the very least, we managed to stop this wave.”
“Mission complete. I hurried to absorb the materials into my weapon, but… Chimera isn’t exactly top-tier as a weapon material.”
“Well, yeah…”
“It’s better than nothing. You’d regret underestimating its unsealing effects.”
“I suppose that’s true.”
“Either way, I’m exhausted. Let’s rest at an inn first, then head to Faubrey.”
And so, we decided to stay at an inn for the night. Father and the others all took their time to rest.
“So… that’s what a wave is…”
The assistant murmured, directing the words toward the rival.
“Gauw…”
“I just clung to Windia-chan and Gaelion-chan the whole time, but… it was scary…”
The mole slid off the rival’s back, trembling with fear.
“You okay?”
Father asked, checking on the assistant and the others, including Sakura-chan.
“Is everyone unhurt? I’m not the best at healing magic, but if anyone’s injured, I can use it, and I have some healing potions too.”
“I’m fine.”
“Gau.”
“Yeah.”
“Sakura’s not hurt either!”
“Neither am I.”
“Koh is fine too!”
“I see. That’s a relief.”
Has there ever been such an easy wave before? Thinking back, I feel like I’ve spent most of my time worrying about Ren and Itsuki. Still, it feels like all our struggles so far have finally paid off.
“Hey, hey, Iwatani.”
“What is it, Kou?”
While we were resting in front of the inn, Kou looked up at Father with puppy-dog eyes.
“Food.”
“I’d like you to bear with the inn’s food just for today.”
“Ehh…”
Even Father is tired. That much should be understandable. I subtly signal Kou to come over this way.
“Hey, Iwatani.”
“I told you, no. Sorry, but today you’ll have to—”
“When’s the mole gonna be cooked?”
The air froze. I was speechless, staring at Kou.
“Kou wants hotpot! Mole hotpot!”
“Eeek!”

The mole hid behind the rival. It seems it understands that Filolials and it don’t get along. Judging by their relationship, it must have figured it would be safest sticking close to the rival and the assistant.
“Kou-san… Don’t tell me you really didn’t understand?”
Itsuki sighed, half exasperated, as he spoke to Kou.
“What do you mean? Am I wrong?”
“Sigh… Father, I think Kou-san believes Imiya is livestock, meant to be raised and then eaten.”
This atmosphere… I recognize it! I need to put a stop to this immediately.
For Kou’s sake!
“Kou, it’s not too late! Apologize to Father now! Otherwise, you’ll end up going through something awful!”
“Huh? What’s gonna happen?”
“Last time, Kou got so scared that just bringing it up would make her tremble in fear!”
“W-What’s going to happen?”

“Isn’t it just Naofumi-san’s usual discipline? If that’s the case, then it’s perfect. Naofumi-san, while you’re at it, please scold Kou-san about her obsession with my hair, too… Look at my split ends!”

Now that he mentions it, Itsuki’s hair does look messier than usual. But Itsuki, this isn’t the time for that. Kou is in danger here. Itsuki probably assumes Father will just give a light scolding. But considering what happened with Keel last time, Kou’s reaction might push Father to get really angry. This situation is bad.
“Every single day, she keeps nibbling on my hair! No matter how many times I tell her to stop, she won’t!”
“That’s… yeah, if she keeps doing it, you should definitely say something.”
Father cleared his throat and turned to Kou.
Alright, Kou! Show some remorse now!
“Kou, Imiya-chan isn’t food. Do you understand?”
“Hmm?”
Kou tilted her head. She even looked like she was grinning slightly. That’s a bad sign. Father turned his attention to Sakura-chan and Yuki-chan.
“Sakura-chan, Yuki-chan, you understand, right?”
“Yeah, at first, I thought Imiya-chan looked tasty, but now she’s a friend!”
“Indeed. Eating her would be most improper.”
“W-Well… Anyway, Imiya-chan is a beastman, not livestock or a monster. Do you get it?”
“Hmm… Not really. She looks so tasty, so why can’t we eat her?”
Among the Filolials, Kou isn’t exactly the brightest. But she makes up for it with boundless curiosity and a fearless nature.
Ugh… Just remembering last time is making my head hurt!
